name: f1-feldspar-iron
note: The user's own late-game world (a copy; 42 h, 18 mods incl. Cybersyn, 261 roboports, biters removed by the harness). Iron is the real bottleneck: production ~= use at ~7,200/min while 91 consumers starve. Exactly the user's example order.

objectives.name: fix-iron
objectives.goal: @{agent} our iron is the bottleneck: a lot of machines are starved of iron plates. Go fix it.

score.name: iron_made_per_min
score.note: +900/min (a yellow belt) over the start; starved consumers soak it up, so made tracks capacity

score.name: iron_starved_machines
score.lua: local k=0 for _,a in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{type={'assembling-machine','furnace'}, force=f}) do if a.status==defines.entity_status.item_ingredient_shortage then local r=a.get_recipe() if r then for _,i in pairs(r.ingredients) do if i.name=='iron-plate' then k=k+1 break end end end end end return k

score.name: science_packs_used
score.lua: local n=0 for _,p in pairs{'automation-science-pack','logistic-science-pack','chemical-science-pack','production-science-pack','utility-science-pack','space-science-pack','military-science-pack'} do n=n+st.get_output_count(p) end return n
